seen_animation: Frame 1: a tall tapered black-line tower fills the middle of the frame with its top cut off at the upper edge; horizontal stroke lines cross it as bands; grey scenery shows a leafy bush at lower left, a long curved line at right and a small cloud at lower right. Frames 2-4: the tower slides down in the frame, so the bands move lower and the top of the tower comes into view: the small window shape and the short horizontal beam lines on both sides of the top appear by frame 3. Frame 5: the full top of the tower, the lamp box with its window and the beam lines, sits just under the top edge; the scenery has also moved down (bush lower, a small cloud now beside the top). Frames 6-16: the tower keeps drifting down slowly and gets slightly smaller, the top settling about a quarter of the way down the frame; grey scenery keeps scrolling down, with a large blob shape entering at the upper left around frames 7-9 and a small leaf entering at the top right at frame 12 and moving down through frame 16. The tower's construction stays the same in every frame.
seen_film: A red-and-white striped lighthouse photographed from below against a grey-blue sky, framed by dark tree foliage on the left and bare branches on the right. Frames 1-4: the camera tilts up (and pulls back slightly): the striped tower moves down in the frame, the top first cut off, then the black gallery ring enters at frame 3. Frame 5: the lantern room is visible just under the top edge. Frames 6-16: the movement slows; the lighthouse continues to sink slightly and narrow, with the lantern ending about a quarter of the way down the frame by frame 16. The trees stay at the left and right edges throughout.
named_subject: A lighthouse: a tapered tower with horizontal band lines, a lamp room with a window on top, and short horizontal light-beam lines on both sides of the top.
evidence: Frame 1 in both: tower fills the center with its top above the frame edge and width about one quarter of the panel. Frame 3 in both: the top/gallery region reaches the upper edge (animation shows the window shape, film shows the gallery ring). Frame 5 in both: the lantern top sits just under the upper edge. Frames 8 and 16 in both: the top lies at about 8% and 25% of the panel height respectively, and the tower bottom width shrinks slightly (animation about 95 px in frame 1 to about 80 px in frame 16; film similar). The band lines in the animation move down by steady, decreasing steps (roughly 10-15 px per frame in frames 1-5, a few px per frame after frame 8), matching the film's fast-then-slow tilt. The grey scenery scrolls down consistently with the tower, so new shapes (blob in frames 7-9, leaf in frame 12) enter from the top edge rather than popping in place. Judged from still frames only.
primary_gap: The grey scenery does not reproduce the film's framing of dense tree foliage on the left edge and branches on the right edge in every frame; instead the left side shows a low bush early and a large rounded blob later, leaving the sides mostly empty in frames 5-8.
closes_when: Grey foliage lines occupy the left edge and branch lines occupy the right edge in all 16 frames, at the same positions as the trees in d.png, scrolling down with the tilt.
protect: The tower's doodle construction from c.png (tapered sides, uneven horizontal band strokes, lamp box with the small hexagonal window, the short stroke at the top-left of the lamp, the paired beam lines on both sides); the fast-then-slow downward drift and slight shrink that match the film's tilt and pull-back timing; the consistent scrolling of the scenery with no pops.
identity_gap: The tower is drawn with the same strokes as c.png in every frame; the only difference is that the lowest band strokes are cropped by the frame edge in later frames, which follows from the camera framing.
